name: Forn de la Plaça
tagline: Bread, pastry and coffee in Poble-sec, Barcelona, since 1954.
taxNote: All prices include VAT at 10%, the reduced rate for food.
allergenStatement: One kitchen, and gluten, egg, milk, nuts and soy all pass through it every day. Nothing leaves here certified free of any of them. Tell us when you order and we will tell you what we can do.

voice.headline: Coffee every morning. Cake when its day comes.
voice.lede: Four marble tables, an oven that has been here since 1954, and a counter you can stand at. The coffee is the same every day. Everything else depends on the date.

shopfront.alt: The counter and the tables, mid-morning, with the pastry case lit
shopfront.caption: Mid-morning, Carrer de Blai.

shop.head: Stay as long as you like.
body: We open at half past seven. The bread comes out in two batches, the first at eight and the second around one, and the pastry is made overnight.
There are four marble tables and a counter you can stand at. Nobody will ask you to order again, and nobody will take the cup away while you are still reading.
shop.alt: A slice of cake and a coffee on a café table

voice.motto: El calendari mana — the calendar decides.

year.note: There is a figurine and a dried bean baked inside. Whoever gets the bean pays for the tortell.
The tortell for the Tres Tombs procession.
A book, a rose and a coca.
The godparent gives it to the godchild. As many figures as the child has years.
Candied fruit and pine nuts. Eaten on the beach, at night.
Marzipan and pine nuts. The castanyada is the same night.
Neules and torró, and the tió at home.

visit.lede: Carrer de Blai is the pedestrian street that runs down the middle of Poble-sec. We are on it, about halfway along, with the marble counter you can see from the door.

getting.what: Paral·lel (L2, L3) or Poble Sec (L3). Either way you walk down into the neighbourhood.
Carrer de Blai has no cars on it. Come in from either end and keep going until you smell it.
There are racks at the Paral·lel end. We have nowhere to put one inside, sorry.

visit.room: Four marble tables and a counter you can stand at. It fills up between eight and nine with people on their way somewhere, and empties again by half past ten.
